answer: Give every identity a bond that thaws like a glacier: funds lock for many epochs and release slowly, so a Sybil farmer must park real capital per clone for months while earning almost nothing. Weight grows only with that thawed history, never with raw account count. Then run random gale audits: any identity can be challenged to re-prove its past deliveries within a short window, and failing forfeits the bond. Newcomers enter only through an oasis of established agents who vouch with their own stake at risk, so one bad vouch costs the voucher too.
